newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Selecta stockholders approve capital hike.
newsitem.headline: Selecta stockholders approve capital hike.

text.p: Stockholders of Selecta Dairy Products Inc approved on Friday the increase in the company's authorised capital stock to 1.2 billion pesos from 800 million pesos, officials said.
Selecta is the ice cream unit of RFM corp.
The increase in capital stock created an additional 200 million pesos worth of common shares and 200 million pesos worth of preferred shares.
Stockholders also approved the transfer of the milk and juices division of RFM Corp to Selecta.
RFM had said it will swap the assets of the milk and juices division, worth 380 million pesos, for 190 million convertible preferred shares of Selecta.
"This would make Selecta a more complete dairy company comparable to other daily conglomerates such as Meiji, Mornaga and Snow, " said RFM President Jose Concepcion in a statement.
He said he expected Selecta's net income in calendar year 1997 to reach 145 million pesos this year, 180 million pesos in 1998 and 216 million pesos in 1999.
This would translate to an earnings per share of 24 centavos this year and 30 centavos in 1998, the company said in a statement.
Last year, the company posted an unaudited net income of about 100 million pesos with total sales of 1.41 billion pesos.
Selecta said it has earmarked 70 million pesos this year to expand its product lines to meet the strong market demand for milk and juice drinks.
It added it will be launching a new product - Hershey Chocolate milk drink, a popular international brand.
